SessionStart.command:
# spec: docs/repo/hooks.md
bun -e 'try { const e=await Bun.stdin.json(); for(const dir of [...(e.workspacePaths??[]),process.cwd()]) {const g=Bun.spawnSync(["git","-C",dir,"rev-parse","--show-toplevel"]); if(g.exitCode) continue; const file=require("node:path").join(g.stdout.toString().trim(),".agents/hooks/runtime.ts"); if(!await Bun.file(file).exists()) continue; const m=await import(require("node:url").pathToFileURL(file).href); const out=m.dispatch("agy",process.argv[1],e); if(out) console.log(JSON.stringify(out)); break} } catch {console.log("{}")}' start
